points.label: Terminal icon responds during the sandbox boot
points.summary: Feedback #38 reported the terminal button doing nothing. It used to refuse to switch until the Linux VM had printed something, which is 25-80 seconds after the icon appears. Now every tap does something. With the execution sandbox knob ON, reload the page and tap the terminal icon (>_ , upper right) IMMEDIATELY, while the system is still starting. PASS: the screen switches to the dark terminal view straight away, and it shows the boot progress line (a bar, a step count, the seconds, and a rotating quip) updating as the system comes up — not a blank black screen and not nothing at all.

actions.text: Turn the execution sandbox knob ON if it is off (the page reloads to isolate). Then reload once more and tap the terminal icon in the top right within a second or two of the page appearing — before anything has run.

points.label: Terminal icon cycles all three views and shows real output
points.summary: The terminal icon cycles three views: terminal behind the chat (faint characters in the background), terminal in front (dark full-screen terminal), and terminal hidden (no terminal at all). Send the prefilled question, wait for the answer, then tap the icon three times. PASS: each tap visibly changes the screen, the icon itself changes appearance to match (filled / outlined / dimmed), the dark terminal view shows the real commands and their output, and the third tap returns you to where you started.

actions.text: The execution sandbox knob must be ON. Send the prefilled message and let it finish before tapping.

points.label: Terminal icon cycles the graph too in Orchestrator
points.summary: Orchestrator has its own background — the slowly rotating wireframe workflow graph — on top of the terminal. The terminal icon now walks every combination of the two, five steps: both behind the chat, terminal in front, terminal only (no graph), graph only, then neither. Switch to Orchestrator in the chat-mode dropdown with the execution sandbox ON, and tap the icon five times. PASS: each tap visibly changes what is behind the chat, you can reach a state with the graph but no terminal text AND a state with terminal text but no graph, the fifth tap leaves a clean chat, and the sixth returns to both. Switching to another mode and back should not leave the graph stuck on or off.

actions.text: Pick Orchestrator in the chat-mode dropdown in the composer. The execution sandbox knob should be ON so there is terminal text to see alongside the graph.

points.label: Terminal icon works the same on Se/cure
points.summary: The same terminal icon and the same three views exist on the client-side tier. On /cure, with the execution sandbox enabled in settings, reload and tap the terminal icon early (while the system starts), then again after asking it to run something. PASS: the tap always changes the view, the boot progress is visible in the terminal view while it starts, and real command output appears there afterwards.

actions.text: Open the gear icon on /cure and make sure the execution sandbox is enabled (an API key must already be configured for the chat itself to answer).
